Root.value / defaultValue.semantic: selected value (array in `multiple` mode); separate from the typed text.

Root.inputValue / defaultInputValue.semantic: the typed text, controlled separately from value.

Root.items.semantic: flat items, groups with items, or a collection from createItems(); nullish entries are unsupported.

Root.filteredItems.semantic: externally filtered list; must preserve flat/grouped structure; with a createItems() collection pass source items; use with useFilter().

Root.grid.semantic: grid layout: arrow keys navigate rows/columns inferred from DOM; use combobox/row.

Root.inline.semantic: renders the list inline (no popup); pass `open` unconditionally; when composed inside Dialog.Root bind open/onOpenChange to the dialog so transient state resets.

Root.highlightItemOnHover.semantic: false allows :hover to differ from data-highlighted.

Root.loopFocus.semantic: arrow-key focus loop includes the input (APG combobox).

Root.openOnInputClick.semantic: opens popup when the input is clicked.

Root.isItemEqualToValue / itemToStringLa.semantic: object-value support; with createItems() both args are derived values and getLabel wins for labels.

Root.name / form / inputRef / autoComple.semantic: hidden input name (inputRef points at the hidden input, not the visible one).

Clear.keepMounted.semantic: keep the clear button in the DOM when not visible (data-visible).

Item.value / index / disabled / onClick.semantic: index improves perf; onClick fires on pointer click and on Enter when the item is highlighted and Input/List has focus.

ItemIndicator.keepMounted.semantic: indicator rendered only when selected unless kept mounted.

Value.placeholder + children.semantic: value formatting; array is read-only/frozen in multiple mode.

Status.semantic: announces async list status politely; root element must stay mounted (never display:none/hidden/conditional).

Empty.semantic: renders children only when the list is empty; requires Root `items`.

Collection.children.semantic: renders filtered list items; List also accepts a function child which implicitly wraps it.

createItems(data, {getValue, getLabel}).semantic: derives selection value + label from arbitrary data (e.g. IDs); create at module scope or useMemo; items must not contain an `items` array property.

useFilter(options).semantic: Intl.Collator-based matcher for externally filtered lists; useFilteredItems() returns the internally filtered items (treat as read-only).

dataAttributes: Input: data-popup-open, data-pressed, data-disabled, data-readonly, data-popup-side, data-required, data-valid, data-invalid, data-touched, data-dirty, data-filled, data-focused, data-list-empty
InputGroup: same as Input minus data-required, plus data-placeholder

Trigger: data-popup-open, data-pressed, data-disabled, data-readonly, data-popup-side, data-required, data-valid, data-invalid, data-touched, data-dirty, data-filled, data-focused, data-list-empty, data-placeholder
Clear: data-popup-open, data-disabled, data-visible, data-starting-style, data-ending-style
Popup: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-side, data-align, data-anchor-hidden, data-empty
Positioner: data-open, data-closed, data-anchor-hidden, data-side, data-align, data-empty
Arrow: data-open, data-closed, data-side, data-align, data-uncentered
Root / Label / Group / GroupLabel / Separator / Row / Chips / Chip / Status / Empty: none
Chip/ChipRemove: no dedicated data-* in 1.8.0 (Chip state is `disabled`; ChipRemove is a button)
renderProp: Same shared contract as every Base UI part: `render?: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state) => ReactElement)` plus state-driven `className`/`style`. Item is memoized (React.NamedExoticComponent) and receives `value`/`index` so memoization can skip re-renders; the docs' 'Memoizing items' section notes memoization helps typing but not mount cost. Custom components: useRender; merging: mergeProps/mergePropsN (see select.json for the full semantics).
controlled: Three independent state pairs: `value`/`defaultValue` + `onValueChange` (selection), `inputValue`/`defaultInputValue` + `onInputValueChange(inputValue, details)` (typed text), `open`/`defaultOpen` + `onOpenChange` (+ `onOpenChangeComplete`). Imperative `actionsRef` is { unmount }. In `multiple` mode the docs' 'Keeping the filter after selection' pattern cancels the change request to keep the query.
formIntegration: Root renders a hidden `<input type=hidden form name value>` (verified in combobox/root/AriaCombobox.mjs, the shared root also used by Autocomplete); `inputRef` is a ref to that hidden input, `form` associates it with an external form, `required` participates in validation, `itemToStringValue` controls the serialized value. Field.Root drives data-valid/invalid/dirty/touched/filled/focused on Input/InputGroup/Trigger.
keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the highlight through items with the input in the loop; ArrowUp/Down from the input wrap according to `loopFocus` (default true). Home/End move the text caret inside the input (not the list). Enter selects the highlighted item; in readOnly it is stopped so it cannot submit. Escape with the popup closed clears the value (multiple -> []) via reason 'escape-key'; otherwise it closes the popup. Backspace/Delete removes the highlighted chip, and with an empty input removes the last chip in multiple mode (ComboboxInput.mjs). ChipRemove activates on Enter or Space. Typing filters using Intl.Collator (useFilter) — this replaces React Aria typeahead. No PageUp/PageDown handling exists in 1.8.0.
notableDifferences: Two controlled pairs (value + inputValue) instead of React Aria's single value/inputValue ComboBox API: Base UI never merges typed text into the selected value, and `itemToStringLabel`/`itemToStringValue` replace React Aria's `textValue`/`getKey` style helpers.
Multi-select UI is Combobox.Chips > Chip > ChipRemove rendered inside InputGroup — React Aria uses TagGroup/TagList patterns that do not exist here.

Item registration requires a real `<Combobox.Item value>` per option; `items` powers filtering/label lookup and `createItems()` builds the ID->value/label collection (a React-Aria `items`+render-function shape is only supported through Combobox.Collection's function child).

Filtering is prop-driven: `filter`, `filteredItems`, `limit`, `locale`, `useFilter`, `virtualized` — there is no `defaultFilter`/`allowsCustomValue`; free-form text is not a value (docs: 'Combobox does not allow free-form text input').
`openOnInputClick` defaults to true here but false on Autocomplete; `modal` defaults to false (Select defaults true).

Positioning/popup composition is Portal > Positioner > Popup (+Backdrop/Arrow) with data-open/data-closed/data-starting-style/data-ending-style/data-side/data-align/data-anchor-hidden/data-empty — no React Aria overlay/placement props.
Item state is data-selected/data-highlighted/data-disabled; there is no data-focused/data-focus-visible/data-hovered equivalent.
